note: Hard B: the difference list of the first new-architecture recipe against its base. A lineage root has no upstream mother (base.json is null), so what this recipe IS, is what it writes on top of the framework stock cfg -- and this file is that statement, path by path. The gate refuses every direction: a changed path not listed here, a listed path that no longer changes, and (env side) a listed path whose named element does not produce it. Rewriting this file is therefore not enough to pass -- the element list has to agree with it.

scene.robot.why: the shared frozen asset: usd, implicit-PD actuator groups, initial pose and soft limits

scene.terrain.terrain_type.why: flat ground is the question itself

scene.height_scanner.why: a scanner on flat ground scans a constant

observations.policy.height_scan.why: the scan observation goes with the scanner

observations.policy.enable_corruption.why: observation noise is a randomization, so it is off explicitly

actions.joint_pos.why: removed: leaving the single-group term would add 26 more action dims on the same joints

events.base_external_force_torque.why: no DR: interval wrench, and it is not c_k-gated in other lines

events.push_robot.why: no DR: interval velocity push, and it is not c_k-gated in other lines

events.reset_base.params.pose_range.why: reset_base must stay (it places the robot); its own randomization is zeroed axis by axis

events.reset_base.params.velocity_range.why: same event, velocity half, zeroed axis by axis

rewards.track_lin_vel_xy_miki.why: the tracking term: full 2D error, exp(-||v_cmd - v_yaw||^2 / sigma_sq)

rewards.belly_contact_force.why: continuous net base contact force, force_scale 706 N

rewards.ang_vel_xy_l2.why: removed: a constraint the first round does not need to attribute

terminations.base_contact.params.sensor_.why: base contact means down, so survival has a definition

curriculum.terrain_levels.why: no curriculum: the framework base's only curriculum term, removed

commands.base_velocity.heading_command.why: off, or the fixed command gets rewritten from the heading error

commands.base_velocity.rel_standing_envs.why: off, or that fraction of envs is commanded to zero while still collecting tracking reward

agent.why: The agent is a class, not a declaration: there are no elements, so these entries carry a reason and no element name. The stock cfg leaves the model and algorithm unset, so the whole of them shows up here -- listed leaf by leaf, because naming 'algorithm' as one prefix would let a field the framework adds pass as ours.

allowed.num_steps_per_env: 24 x 4 substeps = one 1.92 s rollout window at 50 Hz
allowed.max_iterations: 3000, the framework velocity-task default rather than the paper S1 recipe
allowed.experiment_name: lizard_baseline_v1: one version, one log dir (versioning.mdc A)
allowed.actor.__missing__: the whole actor model is set, where the stock leaves it unset
allowed.actor.class_name: the default MLPModel: no three-encoder split, this line has one observation group
allowed.actor.obs_normalization: off: normalization statistics are training state, and this line inherits no state
allowed.critic.__missing__: the whole critic model is set, where the stock leaves it unset
allowed.critic.obs_normalization: off, same reason as the actor
allowed.critic.distribution_cfg: null: the critic has no distribution
allowed.algorithm.__missing__: the whole algorithm block is set, where the stock leaves it unset
allowed.algorithm.num_mini_batches: 4 (the framework velocity-task value; the paper S1 recipe's 11 belongs to 4096 envs)
allowed.algorithm.gamma: 0.99, the framework task value rather than the paper's 0.996
